releases.releaseNotes: Fewer Bluetooth drops: while connected the Ring listens for the phone twice as often and transmits a stronger signal, and after an unexpected drop it advertises quickly for 30 seconds so the phone reconnects within seconds. With haptics on, a gentle buzz every 30 seconds reminds you a tap or app recording is still running. The charging light stays green once the Ring is full instead of turning amber on top-ups. Adds disconnect diagnostics. Includes everything in P19-rc.1.
